zh.title: Open House：要不要办，怎么准备，怎么保证安全
zh.seo_title: Open House 准备与安全清单｜陈靖
zh.description: Open House 能增加接触买方的机会，但也有风险。本文说明什么样的房子适合办、上市前怎么准备、贵重物品和药品如何处理、家中摄像头的录音问题，以及租客住的房子要注意什么。
zh.lead: Open House 让更多人走进你的家，也意味着陌生人会进入你的私人空间。办之前把准备和安全都想清楚。

en.title: Open House: Whether to Hold One and How to Stay Safe
en.seo_title: Open House Preparation and Safety | Jing Chen
en.description: When an open house makes sense, how to prepare, how to protect valuables, and California rules on home cameras and tenant-occupied homes.
en.lead: An open house can bring more buyers through the door. It also brings strangers into your home, so plan for both.
